summary: Natural Gas Services Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting (i) entry into indemnification agreements with directors and officers, a routine governance matter, and (ii) completion of a previously announced redomestication from Colorado to Texas. The redomestication, approved by shareholders in June 2026, became effective July 20, 2026, changing governing law and charter documents but not affecting business operations or capital structure. No merger, acquisition, spin-off, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing reflects internal corporate housekeeping and ordinary-course director/officer protections. No deal terms, advisor names, or structural changes applicable. What to watch: none; this is a non-event for special-situations investors.
